title: From Solver Trajectories to Teaching Trajectories: Cognition-Aligned Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation from large reasoning models (LRMs) often uses raw teacher trajectories as supervision. However, this practice creates a mismatch between the goal of distillation and the nature of teacher trajectories. Advanced LRMs typically improve their reasoning capabilities through reward-driven post-training, such as RLHF. This training optimizes them as strong solvers, rather than as teachers that produce reasoning processes smaller models can easily learn. Since smaller models have different "cognitive capacities" compared to their larger teachers, directly imitating raw teacher trajectories can sometimes be ineffective and often requires a substantial number of high-quality samples. To bridge this mismatch, we propose Cognition-Aligned Reasoning Distillation (CARD), an RL-based framework that transforms solver trajectories into teaching trajectories aligned with the student's cognition. translated_title: 从解题者轨迹到教学轨迹：认知对齐的推理蒸馏
translated_abstract: 从大型推理模型（LRMs）进行知识蒸馏时，通常直接使用原始的教师轨迹作为监督信号。然而，这种做法造成了蒸馏目标与教师轨迹性质之间的不匹配。先进的大型推理模型通常通过奖励驱动的后训练（如RLHF）来提升推理能力。这种训练将它们优化为强大的解题者，而非能够产出较小模型易于学习的推理过程的教师。由于较小模型相较于大型教师模型具有不同的“认知能力”，直接模仿原始教师轨迹有时效果不佳，且通常需要大量高质量样本。为了弥合这种不匹配，我们提出了认知对齐推理蒸馏（CARD），这是一个基于强化学习的框架，能够将解题者轨迹转化为与学生认知对齐的教学轨迹。该方法避免了昂贵的重采样……
tldr: 提出CARD框架，通过强化学习将大型推理模型作为“解题者”产生的轨迹转化为符合小模型认知能力的“教学轨迹”，从而在不进行昂贵重采样的情况下提升知识蒸馏效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes CARD, an RL-based framework that transforms solver trajectories of large reasoning models into teaching trajectories aligned with students' cognition, improving distillation effectiveness without expensive resampling.
